question: How does renewal work in the Legacy Education Alliance development agreement?
answer: The agreement provides an initial five‑year term that automatically renews for successive five‑year terms unless either party gives prior written notice of termination at least 90 days before the end of the then‑current term [1]. The definition of “Term” reiterates this renewal mechanism and additionally gives T&B the right to terminate after the first year if LEA fails to meet cash‑sales benchmarks [2].
